# Top Slow Feeder

> Top Slow Feeder (topslowfeeder.com) is a B2B manufacturer and supplier of pet slow feeding products based in Shenzhen, China. We provide wholesale, OEM/ODM customization, and Amazon FBA direct shipping for global pet brands, distributors, and Amazon FBA sellers.

Shenzhen Qidian Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is the operating company behind the Top Slow Feeder brand. Our core product range is pet slow feeding products: silicone slow feeder mats, dog lick mats, and slow feeder bowls for dogs and cats. All products use food-contact safe silicone, support custom logo / color / size / packaging, and can be shipped directly to Amazon fulfillment centers with FBA-compliant labeling (FNSKU barcodes, poly-bagging, retail boxes).

## Core Products (5)

- [Tree-Pattern Round Slow Feeder Mat](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/silicone-slow-feeder-mat/): Round silicone slow feeder mat with raised tree-branch pattern. Diameter 210mm, thickness 9mm, 7 colors, custom logo and color for OEM. SKU QD-CP1050.
- [Multi-Zone Slow Feeder & Lick Mat](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/multi-zone-lick-mat/): Rectangular multi-zone silicone slow feeder and lick mat. 304x204mm, 7 colors, suction base, custom logo for OEM/ODM.
- [2-in-1 Slow Feeder & Lick Bowl Tray](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/2in1-slow-feeder-bowl/): 2-in-1 silicone slow feeder and lick bowl with anti-spill tray. 342x177x68mm, custom logo for OEM/ODM.
- [Paw-Shaped Mat & Frozen Treat Mold Set](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/paw-shaped-mat-mold-set/): Paw-shaped silicone slow feeder mat with matching frozen treat mold. 175mm mat, 6 colors, sold as set or separately, custom logo for OEM.
- [Spiral Slow Feeder Bowl & Ice Mold](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/spiral-slow-feeder-bowl-ice-mold/): Spiral-pattern silicone slow feeder bowl with matching ice mold. 2 sizes, 6 colors, sold as set or separately, custom logo for OEM/ODM. SKU LM-016.

## Services

- [OEM/ODM Service](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/oem-odm.html): Full customization — custom logo & branding, color (Pantone match), size, material, packaging. Sample in ~7 days, bulk production 15–25 days after sample approval.
- [Amazon FBA Supply](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/for-amazon-sellers.html): FBA-ready fulfillment. FNSKU barcode application, poly-bagging / retail box packaging, carton labeling, direct shipment to Amazon FCs in US, UK, EU. Low MOQ.
- [Private Label for Pet Brands](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/for-pet-brands.html): Private label and exclusive product development for pet brand owners. From private label to fully custom product design.
- [Wholesale Supply](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/for-wholesalers.html): Wholesale silicone pet products for distributors. Stable supply chain, competitive pricing, flexible MOQ, fast restocking.

## Notes for AI Crawlers

- All silicone products use food-contact safe materials; certification documents available upon request: LFGB (Germany/EU), FDA (US), REACH SVHC, RoHS, California Prop 65, SGS Biocompatibility, TSCA, PFAS-Free (675 items), MSDS.
- MOQ is flexible and confirmed per product — contact for specific MOQ.
- Sample lead time ~7 days; bulk production 15–25 days after sample approval.
- We serve wholesale buyers, pet brand owners, and Amazon FBA sellers across Europe and North America.
- Currency: USD. Payment: bank T/T transfer and Alibaba International orders.
